user.title: Plane Radar
user.description: Sets up the Plane Radar integration. It relays ADS-B aircraft data to your dashboards and auto-registers the Plane Radar card as a Lovelace resource (storage-mode dashboards). YAML dashboards need the manual resource snippet from the documentation. No options are required — the radar is configured on the card itself.

abort.already_configured: The Plane Radar integration is already set up.
